definitions.explanation: A stage in the blooming of flowers, especially cherry blossoms, where about half the buds have opened. Part of a scale used in Japanese weather reports and cherry blossom forecasts to describe the progress of blooming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{五分咲|ごぶざ}きだ。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms are only at half-bloom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{五分咲|ごぶざ}きになった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms in the park have reached half-bloom, so let's go see them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{今週末|こんしゅうまつ}→今週末：30306_konshuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五分咲|ごぶざ}き⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, it's expected to go from half-bloom to full bloom this weekend.

notes:
BLOOMING SCALE:
Japanese cherry blossom reports use a scale to describe bloom progress: {一分咲|いちぶざ}き (10%) → {三分咲|さんぶざ}き (30%) → {五分咲|ごぶざ}き (50%) → {七分咲|しちぶざ}き (70%) → ⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧ (full bloom) → ⟦{散|ち}り→散る：02075_chiru⟧{始|はじ}め (starting to fall). This scale is widely used in cherry blossom forecasts (⟦{桜|さくら}{前線|ぜんせん}→桜前線：13124_sakurazensen⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {五分咲|ごぶざ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossoms at half-bloom)
- {五分咲|ごぶざ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach half-bloom)
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{五分咲|ごぶざ}き (still only half in bloom)
